_comment: PVT corner set consumed by sim/harness/gridspec.py. Schema only: this file carries NO corner values until the ratified spec (issue #2) fills it.
An empty set is refused by the runner so a bench can never claim PVT coverage from an unfilled file.
process[]: klt sim corners.process entries (a bare .lib section name, or {name, sections:[...]}). temperature_c[]: degrees C. supply_v: optional {source: [volts,...]} zipped by index, as in klt sim.
